# Q2 2025 Product Metrics

## Summary

This report covers product performance for the second quarter of 2025. Growth
momentum from Q1 continued, with revenue growing 34% quarter-over-quarter and
churn reaching an all-time low.

## Metrics Table

| Metric          | April   | May     | June   |
|-----------------|---------|---------|--------|
| Active Users    | 16,100  | 17,400  | 19,000 |
| New Sign-ups    | 1,850   | 2,100   | 2,400  |
| Churn Rate      | 1.7%    | 1.5%    | 1.4%   |
| Revenue ($k)    | 112     | 124     | 138    |
| Support Tickets | 260     | 230     | 195    |

## Key Findings

- Active users crossed 19,000 in June, up 25% from the end of Q1.
- Churn rate reached an all-time low of 1.4% in June.
- Revenue grew 34% quarter-over-quarter, surpassing the $370k quarterly target.
- Support ticket volume continued its downward trend, dropping a further 32%.

## Regional Breakdown

| Region        | Users  | Revenue ($k) |
|---------------|--------|--------------|
| North America | 9,100  | 83           |
| Europe        | 6,200  | 39           |
| Asia-Pacific  | 3,700  | 22           |

## Action Items

1. Begin planning for international expansion into Latin America.
2. Launch a referral program to accelerate sign-up growth in Q3.
3. Review pricing tiers to maximise revenue per active user.
4. Continue investment in the support knowledge base.
